lines.zh: 我的糖壳在格瑞克的紫雾里嘎吱作响。
lines.en: My sugar shell creaks in Greckon's purple haze.

lines.zh: 每走一步，地上就粘住一小块我。
lines.en: Every step glues a little piece of me to the ground.

lines.zh: 糖做的脚掌踩过石头，留下黏痕。
lines.en: Sugar soles cross the stone and leave sticky prints.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，甜味先到一步。
lines.en: I come slowly; my sweetness arrives a step ahead.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的雾把我的轮廓舔薄了。
lines.en: Greckon's fog licks my outline thinner as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖在响，像咬碎硬糖。
lines.en: My knees crackle like hard candy being bitten through.

lines.zh: 别嫌我慢，我在等糖浆流回腿上。
lines.en: Do not call me slow; I wait for syrup to flow back.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶都变甜了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass blades turn sweet.

lines.zh: 身体太重，糖心一路往下坠。
lines.en: My body is heavy; the sugar core sags with each step.

lines.zh: 我拖着黏糊糊的影子追你。
lines.en: I drag a sticky shadow along in your direction.

lines.zh: 雾里没人看得见我，可你闻得到。
lines.en: The fog hides me, but you can smell me coming.

lines.zh: 走近你之前，我先舔了舔牙。
lines.en: Before I reach you, I lick my teeth once.

lines.zh: 我坐着，糖霜一点点从脸上掉。
lines.en: I sit still while frosting flakes off my face.

lines.zh: 格瑞克没有太阳，我的糖不会化。
lines.en: Greckon has no sun, so my sugar never melts.

lines.zh: 我在数自己脸上的裂纹。
lines.en: I am counting the cracks across my own face.

lines.zh: 甜味太浓了，连我自己都腻。
lines.en: My sweetness is so thick that even I am sick of it.

lines.zh: 没有人来的时候，我就咬自己的手。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I bite my own hand.

lines.zh: 我的舌头是硬的，说话像刮砂纸。
lines.en: My tongue is hard; speaking sounds like scraping sandpaper.

lines.zh: 紫雾贴着我的壳，慢慢渗进去。
lines.en: The purple fog presses my shell and seeps inside.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人在嚼东西。
lines.en: I hear someone chewing far away in the haze.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两颗化了一半的糖。
lines.en: My eyes are two candies already half dissolved.

lines.zh: 静下来时，糖壳里有人在敲。
lines.en: At rest, something knocks from inside my sugar shell.

lines.zh: 你的脸不甜，可我想咬一口。
lines.en: Your face is not sweet, but I want one bite.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，糖浆从下巴滴下来。
lines.en: I stare at you while syrup drips off my chin.

lines.zh: 你带着铁味，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: You carry the taste of iron, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你站得那么直，像一根棒子。
lines.en: You stand so straight, like a stick of candy.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见自己的甜。
lines.en: I see my own sweetness reflected in your eyes.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看清你哪里最软。
lines.en: Hold still; let me see where you are softest.

lines.zh: 我的笑是刻上去的，收不回来。
lines.en: My smile is carved on and cannot be taken back.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸有点快，是怕甜吗。
lines.en: Your breath quickens; is sweetness what frightens you?

lines.zh: 我数着你身上的血管，像数糖丝。
lines.en: I count your veins the way one counts sugar threads.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我在想你的味道。
lines.en: While you look at me, I am thinking of your taste.

lines.zh: 你的剑削掉我半张脸，糖渣乱飞。
lines.en: Your blade shears off half my face in a spray of sugar.

lines.zh: 疼，可甜味把疼盖住了。
lines.en: It hurts, but the sweetness covers the pain.

lines.zh: 我裂了，裂缝里还是糖。
lines.en: I am cracked, and there is still sugar inside.

lines.zh: 别砍手，我还要留着抓你。
lines.en: Not the hand; I still need it to grab you.

lines.zh: 我碎成几块，又慢慢聚回来。
lines.en: I break into pieces and slowly pull myself together.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了不少斤两。
lines.en: That blow cost me a good deal of weight.

lines.zh: 你听见了吗，我在嘎吱作响。
lines.en: Did you hear that? I am creaking all over.

lines.zh: 我退半步，把糖壳收得更紧。
lines.en: I step back and pull my sugar shell tighter.

lines.zh: 伤口在流糖浆，不是血。
lines.en: What runs from the wound is syrup, not blood.

lines.zh: 我不怕疼，我怕你要停手。
lines.en: I do not fear pain; I fear you might stop.

lines.zh: 面包？我更想吃拿着面包的手。
lines.en: Bread? I would rather eat the hand holding it.

lines.zh: 你把糖放下，我会连你一起舔。
lines.en: Set the sugar down and I will lick you too.

lines.zh: 那些甜食对我没用，我自己就是糖。
lines.en: Sweets do nothing for me; I am made of sugar.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想嚼点热的。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want something warm to chew.

lines.zh: 你的手，闻着很甜。
lines.en: Your hands smell sweet.

lines.zh: 别喂我，我的牙会先咬到你的指节。
lines.en: Do not feed me; my teeth find your knuckles first.

lines.zh: 糖块在我嘴里会叫，你信吗。
lines.en: Sugar lumps scream inside my mouth; do you believe that?

lines.zh: 我要的不是食物，是你靠近一点。
lines.en: I do not want food; I want you a little closer.

lines.zh: 你把甜的东西藏起来也没用。
lines.en: Hiding your sweet things will not help you.

lines.zh: 我闻到糖，也闻到你皮肤下的盐。
lines.en: I smell sugar, and the salt beneath your skin.

lines.zh: 撞上来吧，我的壳比你想的黏。
lines.en: Walk into me; my shell is stickier than you think.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，袖子就归我了。
lines.en: Touch me and your sleeve belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我贴住你，糖浆顺着缝往里流。
lines.en: I press close and syrup runs into the seams.

lines.zh: 别推，我一块一块掉在你脚边。
lines.en: Do not push; I crumble piece by piece at your feet.

lines.zh: 我们的骨头隔着一层糖在敲。
lines.en: Our bones knock together through a layer of sugar.

lines.zh: 你身上沾了我的味，洗不掉的。
lines.en: My taste is on you now, and it will not wash off.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的脸颊就塌了半边。
lines.en: One bump and half my cheek caves in.

lines.zh: 我黏在你铠甲上，像一块糖渍。
lines.en: I stick to your armor like a sugar stain.

lines.zh: 你退开时，带走了我的一层皮。
lines.en: When you pull away, you take a layer of my skin.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，你会先闻到甜味。
lines.en: This close, you will smell the sweetness first.

lines.zh: 找伴侣？我连自己的脸都黏不住。
lines.en: A mate? I cannot even keep my own face attached.

lines.zh: 两团糖凑在一起，只会粘成一堆。
lines.en: Two lumps of sugar only merge into one sticky heap.

lines.zh: 格瑞克里没有谁能甜得过我。
lines.en: No one in Greckon is sweeter than I am.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我不想把你融进来。
lines.en: Come no closer; I do not want to dissolve you in.

lines.zh: 我的同类都在互相啃食。
lines.en: My own kind do nothing but chew each other.

lines.zh: 糖与糖之间，没有温柔这回事。
lines.en: Between sugars there is no such thing as tenderness.

lines.zh: 我试过拥抱，结果只剩一滩。
lines.en: I once tried an embrace; only a puddle remained.

lines.zh: 你问这个，我的糖壳都在发烫。
lines.en: Ask that again and my sugar shell heats up.

lines.zh: 我只和饿的东西待在一起。
lines.en: I keep company only with things that are hungry.

lines.zh: 走开，甜味混在一起会招来更大的。
lines.en: Go away; mixed sweetness draws something larger.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的糖渣，塞回脸上。
lines.en: I pick up fallen sugar crumbs and press them back.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的我，我都收好。
lines.en: Every bit of me that falls, I collect again.

lines.zh: 这把剑太凉，我拿着会化。
lines.en: This blade is too cold; holding it would melt me.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，只是想看看能不能吃。
lines.en: I pick things up only to see if they can be eaten.

lines.zh: 你掉的碎屑，比你的肉香。
lines.en: The crumbs you drop smell better than your flesh.

lines.zh: 我把石子当成糖，咬碎了三颗。
lines.en: I mistook three pebbles for candy and crushed them.

lines.zh: 手里握不住，糖总是滑走。
lines.en: Nothing stays in my grip; the sugar always slips.

lines.zh: 这只手里还留着上个人的味道。
lines.en: This hand still holds the taste of the last one.

lines.zh: 我捡起花瓣，塞进嘴里嚼。
lines.en: I pick up a petal and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 你们掉的东西，最后都进我的壳。
lines.en: Whatever you drop ends up inside my shell.

lines.zh: 甜味之外，我终于闻到活的东西。
lines.en: Past the sweetness, I finally smell something alive.

lines.zh: 你动了，我的牙就先醒了。
lines.en: You moved, and my teeth woke first.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，格瑞克的雾让开。
lines.en: I see you now; Greckon's fog steps aside.

lines.zh: 目标是你，别的都不够甜。
lines.en: The target is you; nothing else is sweet enough.

lines.zh: 我的脸慢慢转向你，很慢很稳。
lines.en: My face turns toward you, slowly and steadily.

lines.zh: 你踏碎糖壳的每一下，我都记下。
lines.en: I count every crunch of sugar shell you break.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我开始分泌糖浆。
lines.en: Close enough; my syrup begins to flow.

lines.zh: 我要的是你这副会热的身体。
lines.en: I want that body of yours that stays warm.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，照得我牙发亮。
lines.en: Your torch makes my teeth shine.

lines.zh: 来了，别跑，跑起来更甜。
lines.en: There you are; do not run. Running makes you sweeter.

lines.zh: 我的糖壳绷紧，准备裂开咬人。
lines.en: My sugar shell tightens, ready to split and bite.

lines.zh: 格瑞克把你交给我了。
lines.en: Greckon has handed you over to me.

lines.zh: 我从雾里认出了你的心跳。
lines.en: I picked your heartbeat out of the fog.

lines.zh: 现在开始，我只看着你一个。
lines.en: From now on I watch only you.

lines.zh: 你身上的甜味不一样，是热的。
lines.en: The sweetness on you is different. It is warm.

lines.zh: 雾薄了一点，正好看见你的背。
lines.en: The mist thinned. Just enough to see your back.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，甜味替我指路。
lines.en: I follow you, and the sweetness points the way.

lines.zh: 你转弯，我也转弯，慢半拍。
lines.en: You turn, I turn, half a step behind.

lines.zh: 别回头，我的脸就在你影子旁。
lines.en: Do not look back; my face is beside your shadow.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边掉糖，你顺着找得到。
lines.en: I shed sugar as I walk; follow the trail back.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的糖霜地上，你脚步声发黏。
lines.en: On Greckon's sugared ground, your steps stick.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会浪费甜味。
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting wastes the sweetness.

lines.zh: 我把你的路线咬成一条直线。
lines.en: I bite your path down to a single straight line.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，糖浆还在滴。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree, but the syrup still drips.

lines.zh: 我贴着你留下的味道往前挪。
lines.en: I shuffle forward along the taste you leave.

lines.zh: 你的铠甲在响，比你的心跳好认。
lines.en: Your armor rings louder than your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我不急，糖有的是时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; sugar has all the time.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我的牙越痒。
lines.en: The more you run, the more my teeth itch.

lines.zh: 这道甜味只有你身上有。
lines.en: This particular sweetness exists only on you.

lines.zh: 我快到了，你听见壳在响吗。
lines.en: Almost there; can you hear my shell creaking?

lines.zh: 我的糖浆在雾里留了一条线。
lines.en: My syrup leaves a line through the mist.

lines.zh: 你走快些，我听得见鞋底黏。
lines.en: Walk faster. I hear your soles sticking.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走过的草，往前挪。
lines.en: I creep along the grass you walked on.

lines.zh: 你停下来，我就再近一步。
lines.en: If you stop, I take one more step.

lines.zh: 甜味在拐角处断了一下。
lines.en: The sweet trail breaks for a moment at the corner.

lines.zh: 我在你后面，隔一棵树的距离。
lines.en: I am behind you, one tree away.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，先尝到铁的腥。
lines.en: I bite down and taste the iron first.

lines.zh: 十五点的甜，全送给你。
lines.en: Fifteen points of sweetness, all for you.

lines.zh: 我的牙陷进你的肩，拔不出来。
lines.en: My teeth sink into your shoulder and will not come out.

lines.zh: 糖浆顺着伤口流进去，别动。
lines.en: Syrup runs into the wound; do not move.

lines.zh: 我撕下一块，嚼得很慢。
lines.en: I tear off a piece and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 疼吗，疼就对了，会更好吃。
lines.en: Does it hurt? Good. Pain makes you taste better.

lines.zh: 我的脸裂开，里面全是牙。
lines.en: My face splits open, and it is all teeth inside.

lines.zh: 这一巴掌带着糖渣，很黏。
lines.en: This slap comes with sugar grit, and it sticks.

lines.zh: 你的血把我的糖染红了。
lines.en: Your blood stains my sugar red.

lines.zh: 我打中你，甜味一下子炸开。
lines.en: My hit lands, and the sweetness bursts open.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我还留着半张嘴。
lines.en: One more; I still have half a mouth left.

lines.zh: 别挡，糖壳会碎进你伤口。
lines.en: Do not block; my shell will shatter into your wound.

lines.zh: 我尝到你了，这下更饿。
lines.en: I have tasted you, and now I am hungrier.

lines.zh: 打你要用牙，不用手。
lines.en: I use teeth on you, not hands.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬在你的护肩上。
lines.en: My teeth sink into your shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 糖浆滴进你的甲缝，会疼。
lines.en: Syrup drips into your armor seams. It will hurt.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍掉你的盾。
lines.en: One slap and your shield is gone.

lines.zh: 这一下是给刚才那一剑的。
lines.en: This one is for that sword swing.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的袖子，尝了尝。
lines.en: I tear your sleeve open and taste it.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的糖还粘着。
lines.en: When you pull away, my sugar comes with you.

lines.zh: 我从格瑞克的糖雾里凝出来。
lines.en: I congeal out of Greckon's sugary fog.

lines.zh: 先是甜味，然后才是我。
lines.en: First comes the sweetness, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 雾散了，我这张脸就挂在那里。
lines.en: The fog clears and this face is simply there.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，糖壳还在往下滴。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, my shell is still dripping.

lines.zh: 有人在这里走过，我闻到了。
lines.en: Someone walked here; I can smell the trace.

lines.zh: 格瑞克又捏出一个我。
lines.en: Greckon has shaped another one of me.

lines.zh: 我刚成形，牙就已经长好了。
lines.en: I have barely formed, yet my teeth are ready.

lines.zh: 别害怕，我只是刚学会笑。
lines.en: Do not be afraid; I have only just learned to smile.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾让开一条路给我。
lines.en: The purple fog opens a path for me.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，声音像湿糖。
lines.en: I land on the ground with a wet sugar sound.

lines.zh: 新的壳，新的牙，还是同一个饿。
lines.en: New shell, new teeth, the same old hunger.

lines.zh: 你看，我一开始就冲着你来。
lines.en: See? I came for you from the very start.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的糖壳立刻变黑流下去。
lines.en: Fire scorches my shell black, and it runs.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，碎成一地甜渣。
lines.en: I hit the ground and shatter into sweet grit.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我整个人开始化。
lines.en: Once soaked, I begin to dissolve all over.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹散，糖粉飘满整片雾。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into sugar dust across the fog.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个流糖的洞。
lines.en: The arrow punches a hole that leaks syrup.

lines.zh: 魔法烧进壳里，我的甜变成焦味。
lines.en: Magic burns inside my shell and my sweetness turns to char.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连自己的手都啃。
lines.en: Starved long enough, I gnaw my own hand.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，糖壳整片炸开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole shell bursts open.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我终于不再甜了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I finally stop being sweet.
